# REST vs GraphQL: A Pragmatist's View

I've built production APIs with both. Here's the honest comparison.

## REST wins when

- Your resource model is stable
- Caching at the HTTP layer matters
- Your consumers are third-party and you can't coordinate schema changes

## GraphQL wins when

- Clients have wildly different data-shape needs
- You're building a BFF (backend for frontend)
- Rapid iteration speed beats stability

## The real answer

Use whichever your team already knows. Switching costs almost always outweigh the theoretical benefits.
